title: Acceptance recurrence
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $w$ be a binary input word, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The machine has emitted the bit $1$ at some time strictly before $t+1$ if and only if it has emitted $1$ at some time strictly before $t$, or its transition at time $t$ emits $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-state Turing machine over the binary alphabet
